title: Cover still
description: A 1080x1920 cover with kicker, headline (accent word) and subline kept inside the 3:4 grid crop / safe band (y 240-1680), over the standard backdrop or a darkened photo. Includes a drafting guide.

kicker.description: Small mono label (series, part number). Empty to hide.

headline.description: Main text, trusted HTML: wrap the accent word in <span class="serif">.

sub.description: One supporting line. Empty to hide.

photo.description: Path to a background photo you have the rights to. Empty uses the standard backdrop.

photoBlur.description: Blur in px for the photo (0-30).

fontSize.description: Largest headline size; it shrinks automatically to fit the safe band.

guide.description: Show the safe band and 3:4 crop guide. Turn OFF for the export.

lang.description: Language of the copy (BCP 47, e.g. en, tr, de). Sets <html lang>, which drives uppercase rules (tr: i -> İ).

checks: guide is false in the exported PNG
